visual_inspection.method: Inspected matched native mGBA market, wizard, cistern, bridge, ladder and right-outfall PNGs for all five primary options. Inspected actual water chronology at video ticks0/4/8/12/16/20/24/28, frog crops0/24/96/198/237, and wizard crops0/64/128/192/256. Enlarged actor crops use nearest-neighbour3x; water/full-room comparisons remain native1x. No screenshot pixels were recolored or game states/poses assigned.
visual_inspection.finding: Ladder arrows are visible below the HUD. Falling water uses pale near-vertical sheets/jets with descending internal highlights, impact foam and separately spreading ripples; it no longer relies on the previous meandering dark root-like contours. The small gold outlet now retains its circular dark mouth and distinct visible falling water in the assembled real room. Crate lids and barrel staves remain recognizable without a green/gray lump above the stack. The frog head/body bob remains connected and the wizard flame stays at its staff tip. No sampled actor, rail or staff-grip presentation blocker was found.
visual_inspection.remaining_tradeoffs: Option4 intentionally has the densest broken masonry and darker grime; option5 uses a busier small-paver grouping. Option2 has separate narrow falling jets whereas options1/3/5 use broader curtains. These are local art choices for user review, not an automated quality ranking or a claim that every viewer will identify every shape.
visual_inspection.coverage_limit: Recordings activate11/15 frog body frames,4/5 heads,5/6 wizard frames andall4flames. Complete authored families are covered by the source atlas and independent packed audit, not claimed as all naturally activated by these clips. Static foot-row identity plus hardware head/body phase are verified; the counter can visually hide feet.
